title: CIS-Transolver: A neural operator for fine-scale automotive aerodynamic flow prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.26337v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automotive aerodynamic optimization requires accurate predictions of both vehicle-scale pressure and velocity distributions and local fine-scale spatial variations near complex geometries. Spectral bias in neural operators hinders the fitting of high-frequency spatial components, limiting fine-scale flow prediction. To mitigate this bias, we propose CIS-Transolver, an automotive flow prediction method that combines spatial representations of local multiscale variations with cross-layer state updates. Geometric moments of orders zero through two encode local feature increments and their spatial correlations, while current observations are combined with states retained from preceding layers to form cross-layer memory. This memory is fed back through the value branch of Physics-Attention at each layer, allowing local fine-scale variations to continually inform the prediction of the overall flow field. translated_title: CIS-Transolver：一种用于汽车空气动力学精细尺度流场预测的神经算子
translated_abstract: 汽车空气动力学优化需要同时准确预测整车尺度的压力和速度分布，以及复杂几何附近局部精细尺度的空间变化。神经算子中的频谱偏差阻碍了对高频空间分量的拟合，限制了精细尺度流场的预测能力。为缓解这一偏差，我们提出了CIS-Transolver，一种将局部多尺度变化的空间表示与跨层状态更新相结合的汽车流场预测方法。零阶至二阶几何矩用于编码局部特征增量及其空间相关性，同时将当前观测与前面各层保留的状态相结合，形成跨层记忆。该记忆在每一层通过物理注意力机制的价值分支进行反馈，使局部精细尺度变化能够持续为整体流场预测提供信息。
tldr: CIS-Transolver通过几何矩编码局部多尺度变化并结合跨层状态记忆机制，缓解神经算子的频谱偏差，实现了汽车空气动力学中整车尺度与局部精细尺度流场的准确预测。
en_tdlr: CIS-Transolver mitigates spectral bias in neural operators by encoding local multiscale variations with geometric moments and cross-layer state memory, enabling accurate prediction of both vehicle-scale and fine-scale automotive aerodynamic flows.
